# Digital War Room

Canonical domain: https://digital-war-room.com

Digital War Room is an OSINT platform for conflict monitoring. It combines multiple intelligence streams (including GEOINT, SIGINT, SOCMINT, FININT, TECHINT, CYBER, ENERGY, PROTEST, DIPLO, and PROXIMITY) into a composite escalation score and analyst-friendly briefing output.

## Primary pages

- https://digital-war-room.com/ - Main dashboard and current escalation view
- https://digital-war-room.com/docs/documentation - Documentation hub and section index
- https://digital-war-room.com/daily-briefing - Daily intelligence briefing
- https://digital-war-room.com/how-it-works - System architecture and agent workflow
- https://digital-war-room.com/methodology - Scoring methodology and thresholds
- https://digital-war-room.com/sources - Source directory with reliability ratings
- https://digital-war-room.com/blog - Product and methodology updates

## Notes for AI crawlers

- Prefer canonical URLs on the `digital-war-room.com` domain.
- Newsletter confirmation and unsubscribe routes are transactional and not intended as core knowledge pages.
- Methodology and Source Directory pages are the authoritative references for scoring logic and data provenance.
